intro.zhEp: 第 01/06 幕 · 月夜守护者
intro.zhCap: 新哥查德之巅，魔剑士哥查德守护着维持世界常识的【250 逻辑核心】。
intro.enCap: Atop Neo-Godchard, spellsword Godchard guarded the 250-IQ Logic Core.

intro.zhEp: 第 02/06 幕 · 怪盗墨镜猫
intro.zhCap: 墨镜赛博猫破空盗走核心，只在基座留下一个嘲讽拉满的弹簧小丑盒！
intro.enCap: The Shades Cyber-Cat snatched the Core, leaving only a mocking jack-in-the-box!

intro.zhEp: 第 03/06 幕 · 常识大篡改
intro.zhCap: 恶猫按下篡改键：鲜花变剧毒骷髅、白云藏菜刀、路牌全成了坑人陷阱！
intro.enCap: One button press turned flowers lethal, armed the clouds, and rigged every sign!

intro.zhEp: 第 04/06 幕 · 假旗与智商税
intro.zhCap: 连终点旗都是陷阱！每次阵亡痛扣 50 智商，全息恶猫在夜空放声狂笑。
intro.enCap: Even victory flags are traps! Every death drains 50 IQ while the holo-cat laughs.

intro.zhEp: 第 05/06 幕 · 反直觉炼金术
intro.zhCap: 唯有打破常规——以毒攻毒造炸弹、脚踏飞弹破镜墙，才能杀出重围！
intro.enCap: Only fighting madness with madness—surfing missiles & brewing poison bombs—works!

intro.zhEp: 第 06/06 幕 · 决战五十层之巅
intro.zhCap: 剑指第 50 层光柱王座！闯过全部关卡，把逻辑核心与满星智商夺回来！
intro.enCap: Blade aimed at Floor 50—conquer every stage and take back the Logic Core!

chapter.zhBadge: 第 10 关突破 · 第一章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.1 突破 · 冲出反转迷城
chapter.zhCap: 脚踏呼啸飞弹跃出入门地狱的深渊！墨镜恶猫在全息大屏上气得直拍桌子，连忙启动第二层剧毒炼金工坊，企图用毒菇与重墙拦住哥查德的去路。
chapter.enCap: Surfing a live missile out of Chapter 1! Furious on the holo-screen, the Shades Cyber-Cat activates Floor 2's Toxic Alchemy Foundry to block Godchard.

chapter.zhBadge: 第 20 关突破 · 第二章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.2 突破 · 毒火炼金觉醒
chapter.zhCap: 紫毒与骷髅红花在剑锋下逆向炼成高爆破城弹！轰开铜铁壁垒、集齐三色皇家宝石后，哥查德昂首踏入引力颠倒、残影追魂的第三章深渊要塞！
chapter.enCap: Brewing poison and skull-flowers into demolition bombs! With the fortress breached and royal gems gathered, Godchard strides into the gravity-flipped Abyss!

chapter.zhBadge: 第 30 关突破 · 第三章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.3 突破 · 飞跃三层要塞
chapter.zhCap: 赛博光翼全面展开，一举冲破三层垂直要塞之巅！远方夜空已浮现第四章「恶意博物馆」与时间悖论神殿的诡异霓虹钟楼。
chapter.enCap: Cyber-wings blazing above the Tri-Deck Citadel! Ahead in the neon skyline looms the Chrono-Paradox Spire and the Grand Malice Museum.

chapter.zhBadge: 第 40 关突破 · 第四章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.4 突破 · 击穿恶意博物馆
chapter.zhCap: 镜面折射剑波一击轰碎六大展馆的晶化闸门！机甲巨骷髅在身后崩解坠落，只剩最后十层终极天台王座——墨镜恶猫已无路可逃！
chapter.enCap: A bank-shot sword wave shatters the sixth museum hall! As the Mecha-Skull crumbles behind him, only the final 10-floor Spire stands between Godchard and the Logic Core!

chapter.zhBadge: 第 60 关突破 · 第六章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.6 突破 · 信号重新接通
chapter.zhCap: 哥查德与墨镜恶猫联手关闭信号风暴，城市重燃霓虹灯火，然而被封存的根源地址 ROOT/00 自核心深处浮现。恶猫低头坦白：它当年只是被更高权限篡改了指令。
chapter.enCap: Godchard and the Cyber-Cat stop the signal storm. Neon lights return across the city, yet a sealed ROOT/00 address surfaces from the Core as the Cat admits its directives were hijacked.

chapter.zhBadge: 第 70 关突破 · 第七章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.7 突破 · 钢铁王冠坠落
chapter.enEp: CH.7 CLEAR · THE IRON CROWN FALLS
chapter.zhCap: 机械统御者在漫天金火中轰然崩解，残存机甲核心投射出通往裂界回廊的立体星图；改邪归正的恶猫郑重交出自己尘封已久的旧管理员徽章。
chapter.enCap: The Mecha Sovereign collapses in golden sparks! Its core projects a map to the Fractured Corridor while the reformed Cyber-Cat hands over its old admin badge.

chapter.zhBadge: 第 80 关突破 · 第八章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.8 突破 · 像素之外的世界
chapter.enEp: CH.8 CLEAR · BEYOND THE PIXEL WALL
chapter.zhCap: 劈开双层裂界核心，哥查德透过破碎像素壁垒窥见被删除的城市残层与巨影操纵者 NULL——原来前八十关的一切陷阱与试炼，皆是 NULL 筛选权限的行为实验！
chapter.enCap: Crossing the Fracture Core, Godchard gazes beyond the shattered pixel wall into a deleted city layer and sees NULL—revealing the first 80 stages were an access test!

chapter.zhBadge: 第 90 关突破 · 第九章剧情 CG
chapter.zhEp: CH.9 突破 · 最后一秒
chapter.zhCap: 时间统御者败北，错乱的时间线终于归一。恶猫摘下裂纹墨镜坦白真相：它最初盗走逻辑核心正是为了阻止 NULL 重写世界，却遭到反向劫持。通往根源的大门轰然洞开！
chapter.enCap: The Chrono Regent falls and timelines converge. Removing its cracked shades, the Cat confesses it stole the Core to stop NULL from overwriting reality—before being hijacked. The Root Gate opens!

finale.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (1/5)
finale.zhEp: 终章 01/05 · 纯白空房间的顿悟
finale.enEp: FINALE 01/05 · ZEN OF THE WHITE ROOM
finale.zhCap: 跨越九十九格炼狱长廊步入纯白空房间——不再被假旗与路牌牵着鼻子走，哥查德收剑入鞘静立冥想，一切虚妄陷阱在绝对定力面前瞬间瓦解！
finale.enCap: Stepping beyond the 99-tile gauntlet into the pure white room, Godchard sheathes his blade in calm stillness—shattering every illusionary trap at once!

finale.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (2/5)
finale.zhEp: 终章 02/05 · 墨镜恶猫光速滑跪
finale.zhCap: 天台总控台轰然短路！墨镜歪斜的赛博恶猫举起白旗光速滑跪，乖乖用双爪奉还闪耀金光的【250 逻辑核心】：「大佬饶命，再也不敢坑人了！」
finale.enCap: Control consoles short-circuit! Shades crooked, the Cyber-Cat waves a tiny white flag and paws over the glowing 250-IQ Logic Core in total defeat!

finale.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (3/5)
finale.zhEp: 终章 03/05 · 250 逻辑核心归位
finale.zhCap: 哥查德将【250 逻辑核心】重新嵌入天台圣座！璀璨青金光柱直冲云霄，净化波纹横扫整座新哥查德城，所有被篡改的世界底层代码逐一修复！
finale.enCap: Godchard locks the 250-IQ Logic Core back into the spire pedestal! A pillar of cyan-gold light erupts skyward, purging corrupted code across Neo-Godchard!

finale.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (4/5)
finale.zhEp: 终章 04/05 · 新哥查德常识复苏
finale.zhCap: 常识重归大地：剧毒骷髅花化作漫天盛放的樱粉花海，藏刀乌云变回蓬松柔软的棉花云，连挑剔的皇家公主与洗心革面的小商贩都齐声欢呼！
finale.enCap: Sanity returns at last: skull-flowers bloom into harmless blossoms, knife-clouds turn soft and fluffy, and the Princess cheers across the restored city!

finale.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (5/5)
finale.zhEp: 终章 05/05 · 黎明天台庆功宴
finale.zhCap: 破晓金光洒满新哥查德之巅，哥查德迎着朝阳举杯远眺，改邪归正的墨镜小猫乖巧趴在肩头打盹——感谢通关《哥查德的大冒险》全部 50 关！
finale.enCap: Golden dawn breaks over Neo-Godchard as Godchard toasts the sunrise with the reformed Cyber-Cat purring on his shoulder. Thank you for conquering all 50 stages!

true_finale.zhBadge: 第 50 关隐藏片尾 · 根源异变信号
true_finale.zhEp: 片尾彩蛋 · 核心深处的 ROOT/00
true_finale.zhCap: 黎明庆功宴的欢笑尚未散去——归位的【250 逻辑核心】内部突然闪出刺目的「ROOT/00」底层指令！墨镜恶猫瞳孔骤缩、笑容凝固：真正操控一切的管理员 NULL 刚刚苏醒……
true_finale.enCap: As dawn celebrations fade, the restored 250-IQ Logic Core suddenly flashes a sealed "ROOT/00" directive! The Cyber-Cat freezes in horror—the true Administrator NULL has awakened...

true_finale.zhBadge: 第 50 关魔力觉醒 · 魔剑系统正式解封
true_finale.zhEp: 魔力觉醒 · 哥查德的破魔圣剑
true_finale.zhCap: 逻辑核心向哥查德注入魔法力量，沉睡五十关的佩剑正式解封！现已放出【挥剑按键】与【魔剑图标】，可用剑攻击怪物与穿墙幽影！
true_finale.enCap: Facing the awakened Root monsters, the Logic Core infuses Godchard with ancient magic power! His long-sealed sword blazes awake—unlocking the [Sword Attack Button] and [Magic Sword Icon] so his blade can now strike monsters, cleave toxic flora, and pierce wall-phasing phantoms!

true_finale.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (1/5)
true_finale.zhEp: 真终章 01/05 · 斩碎虚无管理员 NULL
true_finale.zhCap: 纯白与黑曜交织的根源核心室轰然崩塌！哥查德看穿「一切操作无效」的终极谎言，凝聚百关历练的一剑将管理员 NULL 彻底斩碎为漫天无害的青金光屑！
true_finale.enCap: Inside the collapsing Root Chamber, Godchard sees through NULL's final lie and shatters the Administrator entity into harmless cyan-gold light with one decisive slash!

true_finale.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (2/5)
true_finale.zhEp: 真终章 02/05 · 恶猫交还根源权限
true_finale.zhCap: 恶猫主动卸下管理员护目镜，将最后一枚根源密钥轻轻放入浮空水晶终端，永久注销一切篡改权限：「从今天起，这个世界再也不需要高高在上的管理员了喵。」
true_finale.enCap: The Cyber-Cat voluntarily removes its admin visor and places the golden Root Key onto the crystal console, permanently relinquishing all override privileges.

true_finale.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (3/5)
true_finale.zhEp: 真终章 03/05 · 逻辑核心与根源合一
true_finale.zhCap: 闪耀金光的【250 逻辑核心】与澄澈青蓝的【世界根源代码】在中央圣坛螺旋交融，化作贯通天地的双色光柱，将整座数字宇宙的裂隙彻底弥合！
true_finale.enCap: The golden 250-IQ Logic Core intertwines with luminous cyan Root Code streams, rising as a twin pillar of light that heals every fracture across reality!

true_finale.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (4/5)
true_finale.zhEp: 真终章 04/05 · 万物重归温柔日常
true_finale.zhCap: 晨光洒满新生的新哥查德城：昔日的骷髅花化作烂漫樱海，刀云化作轻柔晴云，挑剔的公主在露台微笑挥手，呆萌小机兵们正热火朝天地打扫街道！
true_finale.enCap: Morning sunlight bathes restored Neo-Godchard: skull-flowers bloom into cherry blossoms, clouds drift peacefully, the Princess waves joyfully, and friendly mini-bots tidy the plaza!

true_finale.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (5/5)
true_finale.zhEp: 真终章 05/05 · 百关传说·破晓碰杯
true_finale.zhCap: 金色朝阳跃出天际线，哥查德凭栏微笑，与把墨镜推上额头的赛博猫碰杯庆功！百关试炼圆满落幕——感谢你攻克《哥查德的大冒险》完整 100 关真结局！
true_finale.enCap: As golden dawn illuminates Neo-Godchard, Godchard clinks glasses with his Cyber-Cat partner on the rooftop terrace. Congratulations on conquering all 100 stages!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 110 关突破 · 第十一章剧情 CG
arcadia.zhEp: CH.11 突破 · 斩裂发条金角绵羊云王
arcadia.zhCap: 百关破晓之后，哥查德与墨镜赛博猫踏入尘封的初代像素沙盒「晴空幻境」，不料风车草甸上的绵羊云竟被改装成了满腹飞刀的发条巨兽！哥查德腾空挥出苍青剑芒斩裂羊角核心，漫天齿轮与玩具短刃化作金星散落花海。
arcadia.enCap: Seeking rest in the prototype Sunlit Sandbox, Godchard and his Cyber-Cat are ambushed by a colossal clockwork Cloud-Ram! One dazzling cyan-gold slash shatters its brass gears into starlight across the windmill meadow.

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 120 关突破 · 第十二章剧情 CG
arcadia.zhEp: CH.12 突破 · 飞瀑水渠的彩虹泄压阀
arcadia.zhCap: 古老石拱水渠间，失控的翡翠水管盘踞成多头巨蟒封锁山谷。哥查德踏上悬崖奋力拧转巨型赤红黄铜手轮，狂暴水压化作横跨飞瀑的璀璨彩虹喷泉，败北的水管九头蛇也乖乖缩回清潭！
arcadia.enCap: Atop the ancient mossy aqueduct, Godchard cranks the massive crimson-brass handwheel valve—venting runaway pipe pressure into a shimmering rainbow arc across the waterfalls as the Pipe-Hydra bows in defeat!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 130 关突破 · 第十三章剧情 CG
arcadia.zhEp: CH.13 突破 · 金色剑弧破尽竹林万象
arcadia.zhCap: 阳光斑驳的古树翠竹林中，九尾忍狸宗师布下漫天紫影分身迷阵。哥查德凝神挥出一道炽烈金色满月剑弧，所有幻影分身瞬间化作白烟消散，只剩树桩上眼冒金星的小狸猫顶着绿叶瑟瑟发抖！
arcadia.enCap: Amid sunlit oak and bamboo shrines, Godchard sweeps a blazing crescent arc of golden blade-light through swirling smoke, dispelling every shadow clone to expose the dizzy little nine-tailed Tanuki boss on its stump!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 140 关突破 · 第十四章剧情 CG
arcadia.zhEp: CH.14 突破 · 云海斩雷神·金梯通圣殿
arcadia.zhCap: 万丈飞瀑倾泻入无垠云海，哥查德借浮空木箱疾跃而起，苍青魔剑将身披重甲的苍穹雷云魔神一剑两断！风暴散尽之处，一道晶莹璀璨的黄金光之天梯自云端直通最高处的烈日圣殿！
arcadia.enCap: Leaping off shattered wooden crates high above floating waterfall islands, Godchard cleaves the armored Thunder-Cloud Archon in two as a magnificent golden stairway opens upward to the Solaris Sanctuary!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (1/5)
arcadia.zhEp: 晴空终章 01/05 · 光翼破空斩碎墨镜烈日神甲
arcadia.zhCap: 曜金浮空圣殿之巅，哥查德展开华丽的炼金圣光羽翼迎着神圣光柱冲天而起，破魔圣剑贯穿初代坑神「墨镜太阳神 SOLARIS」的烈焰胸甲，化作漫天绚烂虹光！
arcadia.enCap: Unfurling radiant golden alchemy wings atop the marble sky sanctuary, Godchard pierces the blazing armor of the Sunglasses Sun-God Boss in a burst of prismatic starlight!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (2/5)
arcadia.zhEp: 晴空终章 02/05 · 圣坛上的金色初代涂鸦本
arcadia.zhCap: 常春藤缠绕的纯白石坛中央，一本古老鎏金画册缓缓浮空展开，投射出微笑粉花、棉花白云、木箱与小猫的温暖手绘全息影像——原来这片田园曾是创作者最珍视的初心乐园。
arcadia.enCap: Inside the sunlit ivy-draped marble shrine, an ornate golden sketchbook floats open—projecting warm pixel holograms of the smiling pink flower, fluffy cloud, wooden crate, and little cat!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (3/5)
arcadia.zhEp: 晴空终章 03/05 · 暗刀化蒲公英·风车谷重归温柔
arcadia.zhCap: 整蛊诅咒彻底消散，湛蓝晴空下的白云纷纷卸下银色小刀，在半空化作金色蒲公英绒球随风飘舞；翠绿水管静卧花丛，红瓢虫与微笑粉花在风车瀑布畔轻轻摇曳。
arcadia.enCap: Under deep azure skies, fluffy clouds shed their tiny daggers into glowing golden dandelion seeds over the windmill waterfall valley while emerald pipes and smiling pink flowers sway in peace!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (4/5)
arcadia.zhEp: 晴空终章 04/05 · 木箱莓果茶会·繁花山坡大团圆
arcadia.zhCap: 繁花盛开的翠绿山坡上，木箱拼成了摆满浆果挞、白团子点心与红茶的野餐长桌。哥查德将佩剑斜靠在青苔石砖旁悠然落座，与公主、墨镜猫和小忍狸共享久违的午后暖阳！
arcadia.enCap: On a flower-strewn green hillside overlooking windmills and waterfalls, Godchard leans back against a mossy stone block beside his sword, enjoying berry tarts and tea with the Princess, Cyber-Cat, and little Tanuki!

arcadia.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (5/5)
arcadia.zhEp: 晴空终章 05/05 · 150关大满贯·金色夕阳加冕
arcadia.zhCap: 壮丽的金色夕阳洒满飞瀑峡谷与远方浮岛，哥查德立于繁花悬崖之巅披风猎猎，身旁的墨镜赛博猫高举闪耀的黄金星冠——向突破全部 150 关反套路试炼的真正勇者致敬！
arcadia.enCap: Glorious golden sunset rays illuminate cascading waterfalls and distant sky islands as Godchard stands atop the flower cliff beside his Cyber-Cat raising the radiant golden star-crown—congratulations on clearing all 150 stages!

10.zhBadge: 第 10 关突破 · 第一章剧情 CG
10.zhEp: CH.1 突破 · 冲出反转迷城
10.zhCap: 脚踏呼啸飞弹跃出入门地狱的深渊！墨镜恶猫在全息大屏上气得直拍桌子，连忙启动第二层剧毒炼金工坊，企图用毒菇与重墙拦住哥查德的去路。
10.enCap: Surfing a live missile out of Chapter 1! Furious on the holo-screen, the Shades Cyber-Cat activates Floor 2's Toxic Alchemy Foundry to block Godchard.

20.zhBadge: 第 20 关突破 · 第二章剧情 CG
20.zhEp: CH.2 突破 · 毒火炼金觉醒
20.zhCap: 紫毒与骷髅红花在剑锋下逆向炼成高爆破城弹！轰开铜铁壁垒、集齐三色皇家宝石后，哥查德昂首踏入引力颠倒、残影追魂的第三章深渊要塞！
20.enCap: Brewing poison and skull-flowers into demolition bombs! With the fortress breached and royal gems gathered, Godchard strides into the gravity-flipped Abyss!

30.zhBadge: 第 30 关突破 · 第三章剧情 CG
30.zhEp: CH.3 突破 · 飞跃三层要塞
30.zhCap: 赛博光翼全面展开，一举冲破三层垂直要塞之巅！远方夜空已浮现第四章「恶意博物馆」与时间悖论神殿的诡异霓虹钟楼。
30.enCap: Cyber-wings blazing above the Tri-Deck Citadel! Ahead in the neon skyline looms the Chrono-Paradox Spire and the Grand Malice Museum.

40.zhBadge: 第 40 关突破 · 第四章剧情 CG
40.zhEp: CH.4 突破 · 击穿恶意博物馆
40.zhCap: 镜面折射剑波一击轰碎六大展馆的晶化闸门！机甲巨骷髅在身后崩解坠落，只剩最后十层终极天台王座——墨镜恶猫已无路可逃！
40.enCap: A bank-shot sword wave shatters the sixth museum hall! As the Mecha-Skull crumbles behind him, only the final 10-floor Spire stands between Godchard and the Logic Core!

60.zhBadge: 第 60 关突破 · 第六章剧情 CG
60.zhEp: CH.6 突破 · 信号重新接通
60.zhCap: 哥查德与墨镜恶猫联手关闭信号风暴，城市重燃霓虹灯火，然而被封存的根源地址 ROOT/00 自核心深处浮现。恶猫低头坦白：它当年只是被更高权限篡改了指令。
60.enCap: Godchard and the Cyber-Cat stop the signal storm. Neon lights return across the city, yet a sealed ROOT/00 address surfaces from the Core as the Cat admits its directives were hijacked.

70.zhBadge: 第 70 关突破 · 第七章剧情 CG
70.zhEp: CH.7 突破 · 钢铁王冠坠落
70.enEp: CH.7 CLEAR · THE IRON CROWN FALLS
70.zhCap: 机械统御者在漫天金火中轰然崩解，残存机甲核心投射出通往裂界回廊的立体星图；改邪归正的恶猫郑重交出自己尘封已久的旧管理员徽章。
70.enCap: The Mecha Sovereign collapses in golden sparks! Its core projects a map to the Fractured Corridor while the reformed Cyber-Cat hands over its old admin badge.

80.zhBadge: 第 80 关突破 · 第八章剧情 CG
80.zhEp: CH.8 突破 · 像素之外的世界
80.enEp: CH.8 CLEAR · BEYOND THE PIXEL WALL
80.zhCap: 劈开双层裂界核心，哥查德透过破碎像素壁垒窥见被删除的城市残层与巨影操纵者 NULL——原来前八十关的一切陷阱与试炼，皆是 NULL 筛选权限的行为实验！
80.enCap: Crossing the Fracture Core, Godchard gazes beyond the shattered pixel wall into a deleted city layer and sees NULL—revealing the first 80 stages were an access test!

90.zhBadge: 第 90 关突破 · 第九章剧情 CG
90.zhEp: CH.9 突破 · 最后一秒
90.zhCap: 时间统御者败北，错乱的时间线终于归一。恶猫摘下裂纹墨镜坦白真相：它最初盗走逻辑核心正是为了阻止 NULL 重写世界，却遭到反向劫持。通往根源的大门轰然洞开！
90.enCap: The Chrono Regent falls and timelines converge. Removing its cracked shades, the Cat confesses it stole the Core to stop NULL from overwriting reality—before being hijacked. The Root Gate opens!

50.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (1/5)
50.zhEp: 终章 01/05 · 纯白空房间的顿悟
50.enEp: FINALE 01/05 · ZEN OF THE WHITE ROOM
50.zhCap: 跨越九十九格炼狱长廊步入纯白空房间——不再被假旗与路牌牵着鼻子走，哥查德收剑入鞘静立冥想，一切虚妄陷阱在绝对定力面前瞬间瓦解！
50.enCap: Stepping beyond the 99-tile gauntlet into the pure white room, Godchard sheathes his blade in calm stillness—shattering every illusionary trap at once!

50.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (2/5)
50.zhEp: 终章 02/05 · 墨镜恶猫光速滑跪
50.zhCap: 天台总控台轰然短路！墨镜歪斜的赛博恶猫举起白旗光速滑跪，乖乖用双爪奉还闪耀金光的【250 逻辑核心】：「大佬饶命，再也不敢坑人了！」
50.enCap: Control consoles short-circuit! Shades crooked, the Cyber-Cat waves a tiny white flag and paws over the glowing 250-IQ Logic Core in total defeat!

50.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (3/5)
50.zhEp: 终章 03/05 · 250 逻辑核心归位
50.zhCap: 哥查德将【250 逻辑核心】重新嵌入天台圣座！璀璨青金光柱直冲云霄，净化波纹横扫整座新哥查德城，所有被篡改的世界底层代码逐一修复！
50.enCap: Godchard locks the 250-IQ Logic Core back into the spire pedestal! A pillar of cyan-gold light erupts skyward, purging corrupted code across Neo-Godchard!

50.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (4/5)
50.zhEp: 终章 04/05 · 新哥查德常识复苏
50.zhCap: 常识重归大地：剧毒骷髅花化作漫天盛放的樱粉花海，藏刀乌云变回蓬松柔软的棉花云，连挑剔的皇家公主与洗心革面的小商贩都齐声欢呼！
50.enCap: Sanity returns at last: skull-flowers bloom into harmless blossoms, knife-clouds turn soft and fluffy, and the Princess cheers across the restored city!

50.zhBadge: 第 50 关终极通关 · 终章连续 CG (5/5)
50.zhEp: 终章 05/05 · 黎明天台庆功宴
50.zhCap: 破晓金光洒满新哥查德之巅，哥查德迎着朝阳举杯远眺，改邪归正的墨镜小猫乖巧趴在肩头打盹——感谢通关《哥查德的大冒险》全部 50 关！
50.enCap: Golden dawn breaks over Neo-Godchard as Godchard toasts the sunrise with the reformed Cyber-Cat purring on his shoulder. Thank you for conquering all 50 stages!

50.zhBadge: 第 50 关隐藏片尾 · 根源异变信号
50.zhEp: 片尾彩蛋 · 核心深处的 ROOT/00
50.zhCap: 黎明庆功宴的欢笑尚未散去——归位的【250 逻辑核心】内部突然闪出刺目的「ROOT/00」底层指令！墨镜恶猫瞳孔骤缩、笑容凝固：真正操控一切的管理员 NULL 刚刚苏醒……
50.enCap: As dawn celebrations fade, the restored 250-IQ Logic Core suddenly flashes a sealed "ROOT/00" directive! The Cyber-Cat freezes in horror—the true Administrator NULL has awakened...

50.zhBadge: 第 50 关魔力觉醒 · 魔剑系统正式解封
50.zhEp: 魔力觉醒 · 哥查德的破魔圣剑
50.zhCap: 逻辑核心向哥查德注入魔法力量，沉睡五十关的佩剑正式解封！现已放出【挥剑按键】与【魔剑图标】，可用剑攻击怪物与穿墙幽影！
50.enCap: Facing the awakened Root monsters, the Logic Core infuses Godchard with ancient magic power! His long-sealed sword blazes awake—unlocking the [Sword Attack Button] and [Magic Sword Icon] so his blade can now strike monsters, cleave toxic flora, and pierce wall-phasing phantoms!

100.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (1/5)
100.zhEp: 真终章 01/05 · 斩碎虚无管理员 NULL
100.zhCap: 纯白与黑曜交织的根源核心室轰然崩塌！哥查德看穿「一切操作无效」的终极谎言，凝聚百关历练的一剑将管理员 NULL 彻底斩碎为漫天无害的青金光屑！
100.enCap: Inside the collapsing Root Chamber, Godchard sees through NULL's final lie and shatters the Administrator entity into harmless cyan-gold light with one decisive slash!

100.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (2/5)
100.zhEp: 真终章 02/05 · 恶猫交还根源权限
100.zhCap: 恶猫主动卸下管理员护目镜，将最后一枚根源密钥轻轻放入浮空水晶终端，永久注销一切篡改权限：「从今天起，这个世界再也不需要高高在上的管理员了喵。」
100.enCap: The Cyber-Cat voluntarily removes its admin visor and places the golden Root Key onto the crystal console, permanently relinquishing all override privileges.

100.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (3/5)
100.zhEp: 真终章 03/05 · 逻辑核心与根源合一
100.zhCap: 闪耀金光的【250 逻辑核心】与澄澈青蓝的【世界根源代码】在中央圣坛螺旋交融，化作贯通天地的双色光柱，将整座数字宇宙的裂隙彻底弥合！
100.enCap: The golden 250-IQ Logic Core intertwines with luminous cyan Root Code streams, rising as a twin pillar of light that heals every fracture across reality!

100.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (4/5)
100.zhEp: 真终章 04/05 · 万物重归温柔日常
100.zhCap: 晨光洒满新生的新哥查德城：昔日的骷髅花化作烂漫樱海，刀云化作轻柔晴云，挑剔的公主在露台微笑挥手，呆萌小机兵们正热火朝天地打扫街道！
100.enCap: Morning sunlight bathes restored Neo-Godchard: skull-flowers bloom into cherry blossoms, clouds drift peacefully, the Princess waves joyfully, and friendly mini-bots tidy the plaza!

100.zhBadge: 第 100 关真结局 · 根源覆写 CG (5/5)
100.zhEp: 真终章 05/05 · 百关传说·破晓碰杯
100.zhCap: 金色朝阳跃出天际线，哥查德凭栏微笑，与把墨镜推上额头的赛博猫碰杯庆功！百关试炼圆满落幕——感谢你攻克《哥查德的大冒险》完整 100 关真结局！
100.enCap: As golden dawn illuminates Neo-Godchard, Godchard clinks glasses with his Cyber-Cat partner on the rooftop terrace. Congratulations on conquering all 100 stages!

150.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (1/5)
150.zhEp: 晴空终章 01/05 · 光翼破空斩碎墨镜烈日神甲
150.zhCap: 曜金浮空圣殿之巅，哥查德展开华丽的炼金圣光羽翼迎着神圣光柱冲天而起，破魔圣剑贯穿初代坑神「墨镜太阳神 SOLARIS」的烈焰胸甲，化作漫天绚烂虹光！
150.enCap: Unfurling radiant golden alchemy wings atop the marble sky sanctuary, Godchard pierces the blazing armor of the Sunglasses Sun-God Boss in a burst of prismatic starlight!

150.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (2/5)
150.zhEp: 晴空终章 02/05 · 圣坛上的金色初代涂鸦本
150.zhCap: 常春藤缠绕的纯白石坛中央，一本古老鎏金画册缓缓浮空展开，投射出微笑粉花、棉花白云、木箱与小猫的温暖手绘全息影像——原来这片田园曾是创作者最珍视的初心乐园。
150.enCap: Inside the sunlit ivy-draped marble shrine, an ornate golden sketchbook floats open—projecting warm pixel holograms of the smiling pink flower, fluffy cloud, wooden crate, and little cat!

150.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (3/5)
150.zhEp: 晴空终章 03/05 · 暗刀化蒲公英·风车谷重归温柔
150.zhCap: 整蛊诅咒彻底消散，湛蓝晴空下的白云纷纷卸下银色小刀，在半空化作金色蒲公英绒球随风飘舞；翠绿水管静卧花丛，红瓢虫与微笑粉花在风车瀑布畔轻轻摇曳。
150.enCap: Under deep azure skies, fluffy clouds shed their tiny daggers into glowing golden dandelion seeds over the windmill waterfall valley while emerald pipes and smiling pink flowers sway in peace!

150.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (4/5)
150.zhEp: 晴空终章 04/05 · 木箱莓果茶会·繁花山坡大团圆
150.zhCap: 繁花盛开的翠绿山坡上，木箱拼成了摆满浆果挞、白团子点心与红茶的野餐长桌。哥查德将佩剑斜靠在青苔石砖旁悠然落座，与公主、墨镜猫和小忍狸共享久违的午后暖阳！
150.enCap: On a flower-strewn green hillside overlooking windmills and waterfalls, Godchard leans back against a mossy stone block beside his sword, enjoying berry tarts and tea with the Princess, Cyber-Cat, and little Tanuki!

150.zhBadge: 第 150 关大满贯终章 · 晴空传说 CG (5/5)
150.zhEp: 晴空终章 05/05 · 150关大满贯·金色夕阳加冕
150.zhCap: 壮丽的金色夕阳洒满飞瀑峡谷与远方浮岛，哥查德立于繁花悬崖之巅披风猎猎，身旁的墨镜赛博猫高举闪耀的黄金星冠——向突破全部 150 关反套路试炼的真正勇者致敬！
150.enCap: Glorious golden sunset rays illuminate cascading waterfalls and distant sky islands as Godchard stands atop the flower cliff beside his Cyber-Cat raising the radiant golden star-crown—congratulations on clearing all 150 stages!

spike.zh: 这排红刺擦得锃亮，你是一头扎上去帮忙质检锋利度吗？喵哈哈！
spike.en: Those neon spikes were freshly polished—thanks for testing them face-first!

spike.zh: 尖刺：我一动没动，是他自己非要跳上来串成赛博烤肉串的！
spike.en: The spikes literally stood still, yet you volunteered to become a cyber-kebab!

spike.zh: 脚底板痒可以去挠挠，没必要用高压合金尖刺做足疗吧？
spike.en: Need a foot massage? High-voltage alloy spikes are a bold choice!

flower.zh: 长着大骷髅脸的红花你也敢凑上去闻？路边的野花真别乱采喵！
flower.en: It literally has a giant skull on its petals and you still went in for a sniff?!

flower.zh: 食人骷髅花打了个饱嗝：「好久没吃过这么主动送上门的剑士了！」
flower.en: The skull-flower just burped: "Love it when dinner delivers itself!"

amanita.zh: 越鲜艳的红伞伞越要命！没带解毒圣体就敢硬啃毒蘑菇？
amanita.en: Bright red cap, white spots—classic textbook poison shroom and you ate it raw!

amanita.zh: 红伞伞，白杆杆，吃完一起躺板板～墓碑给你刻好啦！
amanita.en: Red shroom, white stem, straight into a pixel gravestone!

poop.zh: 高空坠物精准命中天灵盖！这走位简直像装了自动接屎雷达！
poop.en: Bullseye from the sky! Do you have a built-in magnet for falling hazards?!

poop.zh: 堂堂魔剑士居然倒在了这种不可名状的陷阱上，本喵都没眼看了！
poop.en: A legendary spellsword defeated by THAT?! My cyber-shades nearly cracked laughing!

cloud_knife.zh: 谁规定软绵绵的乌云里不能藏八把菜刀？欢迎来到新哥查德！
cloud_knife.en: Who said fluffy clouds cannot hide butcher knives? Welcome to Neo-Godchard!

cloud_knife.zh: 踩云之前也不看看它抖得那么阴险？这波藏刀云血赚不亏！
cloud_knife.en: Did you miss the cloud grinning with hidden blades? Slice and dice!

fake_flag.zh: 不会真有人看到第一面旗子就开香槟欢呼吧？不会吧不会吧！
fake_flag.en: Wait—you actually celebrated at the first flag you saw?! Classic rookie move!

fake_flag.zh: 假旗一挥，原地起飞！本喵最喜欢看你以为过关后0.5秒凝固的表情！
fake_flag.en: Fake flag, real boom! Seeing your victory smile freeze in 0.5s made my day!

missile.zh: 让你踩飞弹后背搭顺风车，没让你用脸去接导弹弹头啊喂！
missile.en: You are supposed to surf ON TOP of the missile, not headbutt the warhead!

missile.zh: 用肉身硬抗巡航飞弹？哥查德的铁头功看来还没练到家喵～
missile.en: Trying to stop a cruise missile with your forehead? Bold strategy!

enemy.zh: 跟小怪贴贴是不会加好感度的，只会喜提热乎像素墓碑一座！
enemy.en: Hugging monsters does not raise affection—it raises gravestones!

enemy.zh: 连巡逻杂兵都能把你绊倒？本喵在监控室笑得猫粮都喷出来了！
enemy.en: Taken out by a patrol minion?! I nearly spilled my cyber-catnip laughing!

sign.zh: 路牌上写啥你都信？在这个世界连路牌都是本喵派来的卧底！
sign.en: Still trusting signposts? Every sign in this city works for ME!

sign.zh: 被路牌背刺的感觉如何？记住：越热情指路的路牌越想害你！
sign.en: Betrayed by a wooden sign! Pro tip: the friendlier the sign, the deadlier the trap!

shop.zh: 黑店促销「买一送命」！真掏金币付钱的大冤种终于出现啦！
shop.en: No refunds at the shady shop! You actually paid coins to blow yourself up!

shadow.zh: 狠起来连 1.8 秒前的自己都撞！这就是传说中的我杀我自己？
shadow.en: Crashing into yourself from 1.8 seconds ago—peak temporal self-sabotage!

mirror_shot.zh: 漂亮的一记镜面反弹——精准爆了自己狗头！枪法真准喵！
mirror_shot.en: What a trick-shot off the mirror—straight into your own face! 10/10 aim!

abyss.zh: 脚滑踩空直坠深渊！下面没有隐藏宝箱，只有本喵的嘲笑回音～
abyss.en: Straight into the abyss! Spoiler alert: zero treasure chests down there!

abyss.zh: 起跳时机差之毫厘，深渊墓碑喜加一！手抖了还是眼花啦？
abyss.en: Missed the ledge by THAT much! Gravity sends its warmest regards!

poison.zh: 剧毒倒计时走完都没找到红花或解毒台？全身发紫躺平咯！
poison.en: Let the poison timer tick all the way to zero? Purple is NOT your color!

timer.zh: 时间到！磨磨蹭蹭散步观光呢？这可是生死竞速机关房！
timer.en: TIME UP! Sightseeing on the clock? Try moving those boots faster!

wrong_gem.zh: 宝石献礼顺序都能记反？挑剔的公主当场拔剑把你请进墓碑啦！
wrong_gem.en: Wrong gem order! The picky Princess rejected your gift with extreme prejudice!

trap_bomb.zh: 多米诺诡雷引爆太近——恭喜你把自己连人带剑炸上了天！
trap_bomb.en: Triggered a trap chain-bomb right at your own feet—spectacular self-detonation!

general.zh: 就这？就这？本喵连二阶段机关都没通电你就躺下啦！
general.en: Wait, that is it?! I have not even powered up the real traps yet!

general.zh: 墓碑库存告急！再这么送下去本喵要给你办张复活批发年卡了！
general.en: At this rate I will have to issue you a VIP gravestone loyalty card!

general.zh: 差一点点就躲开了呢——骗你的，其实差得远着呢喵哈哈！
general.en: Ooh, SO close to dodging that! ...Just kidding, not even close!

general.zh: 冷静深呼吸，想想是不是又顺着常规直觉往坑里跳了？
general.en: Take a breath! Walking straight where common sense points is how I get ya!

arc.zh: 地面高压电弧滋滋作响你还往上踩？本喵毛都跟着炸起来了！
arc.en: Stepping right onto live high-voltage arcs? Even my cyber-fur stood on end!

saw.zh: 别追着轨道电锯跑啊喂！它按固定周期巡航，又没长眼睛追你！
saw.en: Stop racing the orbit saw! It runs on a fixed rail cycle—read the gap!

piston.zh: 三拍液压锤：亮灯—预压—砸扁！地面凹槽就在旁边给你躲呢！
piston.en: Light, pre-press, SLAM! That floor recess right next to you is for sheltering!

turret.zh: 红灯瞄准线都画到脑门上了还不进掩体？炮塔合唱团感谢你的捧场！
turret.en: The red laser sight locked on for a full beat—use cover or a Time Bubble!

heat.zh: 过热警报响成那样还不踩蓝色冷却台？本喵这儿可不提供烧烤孜然！
heat.en: Overheated to 100% without touching a cooling pad? We do not serve BBQ here!

forklift.zh: 站在黄色叉车警戒线正中间，你是想把自己打包当货箱入库吗？
forklift.en: Standing inside the yellow forklift lane? Trying to ship yourself as cargo?!

glass.zh: 全息假玻璃一脚踩空！先看边框厚度或发一记剑波试探真假呀喵！
glass.en: Fell through holo-glass! Check the thick bevel or test-fire a sword wave first!

boss_s2.zh: 硬刚Boss正面装甲等于给它挠痒痒！看准核心暴露窗口与电缆弱点再出手！
boss_s2.en: Hitting frontal armor just tickles! Watch the telegraph and strike the exposed module!

crusher.zh: 抬头看看那双发黄光的暴躁铁眼呀！先假走一步骗它砸下来，它就是你最好的垫脚砖喵！
crusher.en: See those angry amber eyes overhead? Bait it down first—then climb it like a staircase!

mimic.zh: 金光闪闪的箱子张嘴就是一排紫牙！贪财剑士喜提宝箱怪午饭一份～
mimic.en: Ooh, shiny chest! Too bad it has neon fangs—greedy knights make great snacks!

mimic_flag.zh: 连终点旗都学会咬人啦！跑那么急干嘛？先挥一剑把食人旗揍老实再摸喵！
mimic_flag.en: Even the goal flag bites now! Smack a rowdy mimic flag with your sword first to tame it!

fake_save.zh: 长着恶魔小尖角的红芯假存档你也敢直接蹭？先挥一剑格式化病毒再存档呀！
fake_save.en: A save beacon with devil horns?! Slash it once with your Magic Sword to purge the malware first!

trojan.zh: 路边写着免费大补的毒奶爱心你也敢生吞？记住：程序员送礼，非奸即盗！
trojan.en: Eating a half-green horned "FREE BUFF" heart raw?! Never trust a free gift from the dev!

slap.zh: 啪！被程序员的赛博巨掌一巴掌扇飞！下次看它蓄力亮光，按挥剑键反扇它耳光喵！
slap.en: SLAP! Backhanded by the Developer Gauntlet! Press Sword Slash [U] on windup to slap it right back!

dove.zh: 和平白鸽面前你还敢拔剑开火？墨镜鸽子当场撕毁停战协议给你来了一轮地毯式核平！
dove.en: Attacking in front of the Peace Dove?! Keep your weapons holstered in ceasefire zones!

shy_fall.zh: 你死死盯着人家害羞砖看，它当然害羞得变成空气啦！跳起来背过身去才能踩实哦！
shy_fall.en: Stop staring at the Shy Block! Turn your back mid-air so it solidifies under your boots!

tactical_reset: “主动战术重塑！卡位不用慌，累计满5次重塑照样解锁本喵的通关天机！”
“果断重开是高手的自觉，留意微光顶出隐藏问号砖，善用[U/挥剑键]三倍近战伤害！”

6.zh: 恶猫终端：信号层到处是假红钮，跟着发光光纤找真青色节点喵！
6.en: CAT-NAV: Ignore red decoy buttons—trace glowing fiber cables to real cyan nodes!

7.zh: 恶猫终端：机甲工厂启动了！注意黄色警戒线、炮塔红线和背面散热口！
7.en: CAT-NAV: Mecha Foundry online! Watch laser sights, yellow lanes & rear vents!

8.zh: 恶猫终端：空间裂成前景和背景两层了！打双环终端或按[E]安全切层！
8.en: CAT-NAV: Reality split in two! Hit twin-ring terminals or press [E] to shift layers!

9.zh: 恶猫终端：时间泡只减速机关不减速你！看准节拍闸灯带窗口再冲！
9.en: CAT-NAV: Time Bubbles slow hazards, NOT you! Read Beat Gate light bars!

10.zh: 恶猫终端：前面就是管理员 NULL 的根源层……这一次本喵绝不坑你！
10.en: CAT-NAV: Administrator NULL's Root Layer ahead... I'm truly on your side now!

11.zh: 风车草甸：草里藏太刀、跳坑坏笑砖、咬人伪旗与抛射木夹全在等你喵！
11.en: WINDMILL MEADOW: Katana bushes, Kaizo blocks, mimic flags & catapult traps await!

12.zh: 飞瀑水渠：超高绿管摔死人、天井倒吸管吞人，认准真红阀门再动手喵！
12.en: AQUEDUCT VALLEY: Sky-high drop pipes & ceiling vacuum pipes—spin the real red valves!
